risk_note: RV2 by path (orders, union). Two jd go-live prerequisites, neither touching amounts or attribution; the jd endpoint stays demo. First, window halving (02 §7.1, CAP-JD-07): 2002452 stays upstream_rejected per frozen [AC-B1-04zb#24] but sets a platform-neutral UnionError.windowTooLarge; a shared fetchWindow used by increment, rescan and manual windows halves and re-queries within the job, stops at spans of 60 seconds or less and rethrows, and the cursor advances once after the whole window. Re-queried rows are idempotent, so pages, count and fetched can read high while inserted and stored stay right. Second, a jd increment start older than F = now - 90 days + 1 hour by more than the 30-minute rescan tolerance moves to F, by CAS rewind on an existing row or a single-statement insert when there is none, so one slow window is not rewound every tick. Earlier orders are past the platform's query range. One new new Date(ms) with an eslint-disable in halveWindow: it derives from a window bound and never reads the time.
